title: Governments’ AI adoption falls short of potential
discussion_signal: The post reports broad but shallow government AI adoption across 60 economies, with substantial informal use by individual public servants. It makes institutionalization, data, policy, and readiness the central constraints rather than treating adoption as a simple technology race.
linked_research_question: What institutional conditions turn scattered public-sector AI use into accountable, equitable, and durable capability?
limits: World Bank summary of survey research
Reported adoption is not independently validated here
LinkedIn discussion is not a representative public-servant sample
